title: Estimates and decisions have distinct contracts
statement: A finite decision is evaluated against a declared action space, state law, loss and tie rule. The same estimate can select different actions under different loss tables. An estimate or K_corr alone does not specify an action, accuracy or a universal scale of ceilings and floors.
assumptions: Finite named states and actions; normalized rational prior
Every action-state loss is declared in a fixed loss unit
Return every minimizing action; do not break an undeclared tie
Estimation units and decision loss units remain distinct
boundary: These are conditional finite decision tables, not a universal product law. The estimation-to-decision bridge remains open outside a declared operation.
status: definition and exact countermodels; no new runtime estimator or decision authority
runtimeAPI: No new runtime export; these contracts and their native finite witnesses extend the admitted theory without duplicating the engine.
